name: Shion
source:
Honor student at Central High School.

She always looks great and has an arrogant personality, but she is surprisingly caring and trustworthy.

Born and raised as a genuine young lady. Her way of laughing is "Ohohohoho".

"It can't be helped at all. I'll see you!"
